Since people are having fun speculating on $SKHY CPO roadmap supply chains.

I'm gonna do my own guess and say SK Hynix is evaluating Celestial/Ayar. Then doing heavy evaluation into microLEDs past first-gen deployments. 

Both have been kinda working on it for awhile. 

- Ayar https://t.co/s3WWW5lZ4Y

Deepseek 的多模态能力终于上了!

是一个单独的模型，Deepseek V4 Flash Vision EXP。

他们说这个模型在多模态 Agent 上的能力已经逼近了 Opus 4.8。

纯文本能力跟 Deepseek V4 Flash 一样。

在价格上，DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision EXP 跟 DeepSeek V4 Flash 保持一致。 https://t.co/hNClsLPcvR

同时 DeepSeek Harness 已经第一时间支持了这个模型。

还同时发布了文件 API，免费使用，上传过一次的图片，再用文件的 ID 重新引用的话，可以免去重新上传

Most people assume AI is close to improving itself. Researchers handed 6 frontier AI systems a real research repository and 4 hours to improve its training algorithm.

More than 2 in 5 attempts left it worse than it started.

The setup, from Navers Lab, https://t.co/vemU1drUGY, https://t.co/h6nHaMMtbb

Paper here: https://t.co/HUtX0x6FRO

Free prompts and guides at https://t.co/QbTXyXRlOk

Follow if you'd rather build the measurement first than optimize on a guess.

Anthropic just put its full AI training program online for free. Over 20 courses, real certificates, no subscription and no API key.

It's called Claude Academy. Instead of dumping a course list on you, it routes you by where you already are, whether that's never having touched

Courses teach you how the tool works. They don't hand you the prompt to paste at 2pm on a Tuesday.

For that side of it, 30 prompting principles and 10+ copy-ready mega prompts, free:

https://t.co/s8zraLPsrS

The rest of the library is at https://t.co/QbTXyXRlOk

Follow if you'd rather start with the prompt ready than stare at a blank box.
